messages:
olivia chen: Hi team, I started today — hi! :wave: Quick access question: I need to run some infra tests in EU (eu-west1) and also link a billing account for a sandbox project. Who do I ping to get GCP billing permissions and the AWS cross-account role?

raj patel: welcome olivia! :tada: For GCP you'll need Billing Account Viewer on the billing account and Project Editor on the project (or a custom role we give). For AWS we usually add you to the org-role with 'OrganizationAccountAccessRole' or grant the delegated role for the account you'll use.

olivia chen: thanks — who owns the EU billing account? I tried the cloud onboarding doc but it references a billing id that I can't see. Link I tried: https://redwood.company/docs/cloud-billing

jun kim: for EU testing we typically use the "redwood-eu-sandbox" billing account. It's owned by finance-cloud. I don't have their direct alias memorized but @emma li can confirm.

emma li: yep that's right — finance-cloud owns redwood-eu-sandbox. I can put in the billing share, but I need your project ID or I'll create a sandbox project for you. Which do you prefer?

olivia chen: I'd prefer them to create a sandbox project for me to avoid messing with org-level IAM. sandbox name is fine. Also need Compute Admin and Service Account User on the project.

raj patel: noted. cc @infra-bot — can you open an access request for olivia for: (1) GCP: new sandbox project under redwood-eu-sandbox + Billing Account Viewer on billing, Compute Admin + Service Account User on project; (2) AWS: Organization cross-account role on account 'eu-dev-001'

infra-bot: Access request created: #AR-4981. Workflow: infra team will review, finance will approve billing link for the project. ETA ~1 business day.

olivia chen: awesome, thanks. Do I need any special network perms for Shared VPC? My tests will talk to the eu-internal redis cluster.

jun kim: if you need to attach to shared VPC subnets you'll need the 'compute.networkUser' role on the host project + necessary firewall rules. If it's just outbound calls to the redis cluster you usually don't need attach perms. If you want to use Private Google Access, we'll enable it for the sandbox.

raj patel: also FYI for AWS cross-account: you'll get an assume-role ARN like arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole. Use `aws sts assume-role` or set up an AWS profile in ~/.aws/config.

olivia chen: great — can you paste the exact commands I should run once access is granted?

raj patel: sure — when infra confirms, run something like:

```
# assume aws org role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole --role-session-name olivia-session

# gcloud to check project IAM
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-sandbox-olivia --format=json
```

olivia chen: perfect. Thanks everyone! I'll wait for AR-4981 and ping if I hit blockers.

onboarding-bot: Welcome message sent to olivia chen. Reminder: finish security training and SFDC account steps in 7 days. :white_check_mark:

emma li: following up — AR-4981 is assigned to infra team, finance got notified. I'll DM you once billing is linked (should be same day). :thumbsup:
